title: /mission for Claude Code
claim: Product Hunt: /mission for Claude Code — Give Claude Code missions to spawn a team of agents
why_good: Claude Code is an AI-powered tool that allows users to create missions for AI agents, enabling them to automate tasks and manage projects efficiently.
value: Solo founders pay for streamlined project management and task automation that saves them time and effort.
risk: The risk lies in established competitors quickly integrating similar AI capabilities into their existing platforms.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
does: You hand it a mission in plain language; it decomposes the job and runs a small team of agents against it instead of making you chair the meeting.
why_use: Users often find existing tools too complex or lacking in automation, leading to frustration in managing their projects.
gap: Every agent product today still asks the human to be the project manager. The decomposition step — 'what are the five things this actually requires' — is the part non-technical people cannot do and the part nobody has packaged for them.
counter: Squarely inside the biggest labs' roadmap: the moment decomposition works well it becomes a default in the base product, and a thin orchestration layer has no ground left to stand on.
differentiator: The interesting version is not the coding one — it is the same decomposition pointed at a non-code mission a normal person actually has ('plan and produce my mother's 70th birthday'). Cold start CN = 小红书「AI 帮我做了」类笔记的评论区; EN = r/ChatGPT 'I wish it would just do the whole thing' threads. Flagged watch, not build: the developer-facing framing is exactly what the end-user gate rejects.
hook: Someone who can describe what they want built but has no idea how to break it into steps — which is most people, and only incidentally developers.

zh.claim: 独立创始人在没有专门团队的情况下，难以有效委派任务和管理项目。
zh.hook: 说得清自己要什么、但不知道怎么拆成步骤的人——也就是绝大多数人，只是碰巧现在用它的是开发者。
zh.does: 你用大白话交给它一个任务，它自己拆解，然后调一小队 agent 去做，而不是让你来主持这场会。
zh.why_use: 用户常常发现现有工具过于复杂或缺乏自动化，导致在管理项目时感到沮丧。
zh.gap: 今天所有 agent 产品仍然要求人来当项目经理。而「这件事到底需要哪五步」这个拆解动作，恰恰是非技术的人做不了、也没人替他们打包过的那一步。
zh.counter: 正踩在几家大厂的路线图正中间：拆解一旦做好就会变成基座产品的默认能力，薄薄一层编排就没有立足之地了。
zh.differentiator: 有意思的不是写代码那个版本，而是把同一套拆解对准普通人真正手上的非代码任务（「把我妈七十大寿从计划到落地办完」）。冷启动：中文＝小红书「AI 帮我做了⋯」类笔记的评论区；英文＝r/ChatGPT 里「我希望它直接把整件事做完」的讨论串。标 watch 不标 build：面向开发者的这个形态正是终端用户闸门要挡的。
zh.value: 独立创始人为简化项目管理和任务自动化支付费用，从而节省时间和精力。
zh.risk: 风险在于现有竞争者迅速将类似的 AI 能力整合到他们的现有平台中。
zh.why_good: Claude Code 是一个 AI 驱动的工具，允许用户为 AI 代理创建任务，从而高效地自动化任务和管理项目。
zh.consumer_angle: 按现状很弱——今天的用户就是开发者。只有当任务换成普通人自己从头管到尾的非代码差事时才过闸。
zh.edge: 它把「拆解」这一步接了过去——把一句话变成这句话真正需要的五件事——而这恰恰是非技术的人做不到的那一步。

consumer_angle: Weak as shipped — today's users are developers. Only clears the gate if the mission is a non-code errand a normal person owns end to end.
edge: It takes over the decomposition step — turning one sentence into the five things that sentence actually requires — which is the part a non-technical person cannot do.
